title: Colorado Fire Fighter I — state overlay
description: Thin overlay on the national Firefighter I pathway. Use national JPR structure; apply these Colorado-specific conditions.

differencesFromNational.detail: Must be affiliated with a Colorado Emergency Services Agency for the DFPC certification pathway.
Colorado requires minimal certification at Hazardous Materials Operations (not Awareness alone) as part of the Fire Fighter I path.
Written exam (historically 70% on 100 questions), practical JPRs at 100% standard, and a required Live Burn Practical Examination.
DFPC has published transition memorandums toward NFPA 1010 (2024 edition) for Firefighter I with an effective date of 1 July 2026. Confirm which edition is in force on your test date.
Colorado certifications are typically issued for five (5) years under current rules — confirm at application/renewal.
Successful DFPC certification at this level is associated with IFSAC and Pro Board accreditation pathways.

coloradoSequenceNotes: Complete agency affiliation and medical/physical requirements set by the department/academy.
Train to current DFPC JPR skill sheets for Fire Fighter I.
Complete Hazardous Materials Operations certification (Colorado minimal).
Apply for certificate issuance through DFPC process and retain seals/numbers in Career Record.
disclaimer: Overlay only. DFPC rules and adopted NFPA editions change. Verify on official DFPC pages before testing.
